name: strings
title: String units: bytes, code points, UTF-16
measures: Length, slicing, search, and equality on "", ASCII, accented (precomposed and combining), emoji, and Japanese text.
notes: Intended divergence (expected/test.ts.out): RuneScript strings are UTF-8, and string.len, string.slice, and string.index count bytes; TypeScript's length, substring, and indexOf count UTF-16 code units. Both versions also print the code-point count, which agrees. Precomposed é and e + combining accent are different strings in both.
